name: @speedora/render-quality-judge
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): Render Quality Judge Phase C1 ("Render QA" - see docs/ai/render-quality-judge.md). A pure, synchronous composition (no LLM call, no new detector) over already-computed Editorial Director/render-pipeline output - a FinalClipQualityAssessment that honestly labels each of its 6 dimensions as measured, proxy, or unavailable rather than fabricating a uniform score. No DB/queue access at all; see root ARCHITECTURE.md. Consumed by apps/worker's render-clip.worker.ts.
